## What are you contributing?

- [ ] New Theme (`themes/<theme-id>/`)
- [ ] New Plugin (`plugins/<plugin-id>/`)
- [ ] Documentation / SEO / Resource update

## Checklist

- [ ] Added `theme.json` or `plugin.json` with `id`, `name`, `description`, `author`.
- [ ] Verified locally with `python setup.py --validate`.
- [ ] Verified unit tests pass with `python -m unittest discover -s tests -v`.
